updates.name: Hannah Nicklay
updates.bio: Monitoring Coordinator at the Lake Superior National Estuarine Research Reserve, where she supports tracking of both near-term swings and long-run change in the Reserve's water quality, weather and living systems. She holds a biology bachelor's from DePauw and an MS in integrated biosciences from UMN Duluth, and studies how nutrients and water quality shape St. Louis River Estuary phytoplankton.
updates.research_interests: nutrient and water quality dynamics; phytoplankton communities of the St. Louis River Estuary; long-term water quality, meteorological and biological monitoring
updates.current_affiliation: Lake Superior National Estuarine Research Reserve (UW-Madison Division of Extension)
updates.notes: Reserve staff page slug is 'hannah-ramage' but the page heading and text name Hannah Nicklay, Monitoring Coordinator. Existing ORCID checked at pub.orcid.org: name Hannah Nicklay, employment UW Madison-Division of Extension, Lake Superior National Estuarine Research Reserve, Monitoring Coordinator, 2017-present (consistent). Page uses she/her for her.

updates.name: Karina Heim
updates.bio: Coastal Training Program Coordinator at the Lake Superior Reserve, where she designs trainings and technical support so decision makers can act to protect the area's coastal system. She holds a Whitman College bachelor's in environmental studies and sociology and a 2016 urban and regional planning master's from the University of Minnesota Humphrey School, with a land use planning background.
updates.current_affiliation: Lake Superior National Estuarine Research Reserve (UW-Madison Division of Extension)
updates.evidence: Karina Heim Coastal Training Program Coordinator
updates.notes: Page uses she/her/hers for her. No ORCID found (pub.orcid.org expanded-search for Karina Heim returned 0). No Google Scholar link on the page.

updates.name: Kirsten Rhude
updates.bio: Stewardship coordinator for the Lake Superior National Estuarine Research Reserve, working to protect and restore the Reserve's lands and waters and to connect people with them. She studied biology at UW-Madison and water resources science (master's) at UMN Duluth, held limnology jobs in Alaska, Ecuador and Wisconsin, and was a Knauss Fellow in environmental policy in Washington, D.C.
updates.current_affiliation: Lake Superior National Estuarine Research Reserve (UW-Madison Division of Extension)
updates.notes: Existing ORCID checked at pub.orcid.org: name Kirsten Rhude, employment Lake Superior National Estuarine Research Reserve, Stewardship Coordinator, 2021-present; NOAA Office for Coastal Management Knauss Marine Policy Fellow 2020-2021 (consistent with the staff page). Page uses she/her/hers.

updates.name: Molly Wick
updates.bio: Research Coordinator at the Lake Superior Reserve and a social-ecological scientist who does community-engaged, mixed-methods research with tribal, government and NGO partners. PhD work at the University of Minnesota, backed by a NOAA Margaret A. Davidson Fellowship, examined how identity affects people's ties to and access to water at the Reserve. Previously Lake Superior Program Coordinator at Wisconsin DNR.
updates.research_interests: cultural ecosystem services; human-nature relationships; aquatic ecosystem assessment; coastal and estuarine habitat restoration; environmental decision-making; science communication
updates.current_affiliation: Lake Superior National Estuarine Research Reserve (UW-Madison Division of Extension)
updates.notes: Staff page is written in the first person; no pronoun used in the bio. ORCID found via pub.orcid.org expanded-search (only hit for Molly Wick): record name Molly Wick; employments Wisconsin DNR Office of Great Waters - Lake Superior Team (2025-), ORISE / USEPA Great Lakes Toxicology and Ecology Division postdoctoral fellow (2024-2025), University of Minnesota graduate research assistant (2020-2024); ORCID educations list a PhD and MS in Water Resources Science (University of Minnesota Duluth) and an MS in Earth and Planetary Science (University of New Mexico). All match the Reserve page (UMN PhD, UNM MS, two ORISE/USEPA fellowships, most recently WI DNR Lake Superior Program Coordinator). The record does not yet list the Reserve itself.

updates.name: Ralph Garono
updates.bio: A February 2011 Superior Telegram profile reports that UW-Extension had hired him the previous December as manager of the newly designated Lake Superior NERR. He holds a PhD in aquatic ecology from Kent State University, held university, state and federal posts, and ran his own Oregon consulting firm for 15 years.
updates.evidence: Garono was hired by University of Wisconsin-Extension in December as manager of the Lake Superior National Estuarine Research Reserve
updates.notes: Only source is a 2011 news profile (article uses 'he'). The current Reserve staff directory (lakesuperiornerr.org/staff/) and the UW Extension natural resources people page do not list him; both name Deanna Erickson as Reserve Director, so his 'manager' affiliation is very likely no longer current (not marked former here because no page states it; a research batch should mark the row not current). ORCID 0000-0001-9082-8650 (name Ralph Garono) exists but lists no employment, so it was not recorded. Note: lakesuperiorreserve.org is now an unrelated spam site; the reserve's site is lakesuperiornerr.org.

updates.name: Zanden Frederick
updates.bio: Physical Science Technician at the USGS Alaska Science Center. The profile's science and products list the USGS Benchmark Glaciers (Wolverine, Gulkana and Lemon Creek), firn density and stratigraphy data, geochemistry of water sources in south-central Alaska glacial watersheds, and co-authored papers on the glacier percolation zone and on stream water sources.
updates.evidence: Zanden Frederick is a Physical Science Technician for the Alaska Science Center.
updates.notes: USGS staff profile (read via WebFetch; direct curl got a CloudFront 403) links ORCID 0009-0007-9365-0334; pub.orcid.org record name Zanden Frederick, employment United States Geological Survey (consistent). The profile uses no pronoun. Name order: given name Zanden, family name Frederick. Verifier: research_interests removed because the profile states no interests (it lists associated projects, data and papers; 'mass balance' is not on the page).

Johnson National Grasslands in North Texas, quoted in a June 2024 Forest Service feature on the grasslands' Dust Bowl origins, cooperation with neighboring private landowners, and recreation. Several of the feature's photographs are credited to Deimel.

updates.name: Jeff Stoney
updates.bio: USDA Forest Service district ranger responsible for North Texas's Caddo and Lyndon B. Johnson National Grasslands. In a June 2024 Forest Service feature he describes them as a multiple-use unit hosting oil and gas facilities, public-land grazing, special-use requests and recreation, in an area about 98% in private ownership.
